notes: Renders a plain `<div>`. Field is plumbing: it owns no interactive element of its own, and every keyboard interaction belongs to the control passed into it.

The label/control/description/error relationships are wired with generated ids and `aria-describedby`. The contract records those relationships only as prose in `intent.behaviour`, so this binding is currently the only place they are stated at all — and it states them in prose too.
